cells.gaps: No source found since October 2023 says a law, decree or policy in force classifies government data or requires state data to be held in the country; the Bank of Tanzania's guidelines cover financial providers.
cells.note: Reassessed under Bill's ruling of 2026-10-31 (messages-for-bill 60: a rule must include government or state data): the Bank of Tanzania's 2025 cloud guidelines bind financial providers (TZA-001), and the 2026 report of localisation mandates does not say they cover state data (TZA-002). The government's stated aim to own and control its digital infrastructure (TZA-003) is stage 2.
